import sys, json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def num(x, nd=2):
    return round(float(x), nd)


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])
    facts = []

    def add(entity, metric, period, value, formula):
        if value is None or (isinstance(value, float) and not np.isfinite(value)):
            return
        facts.append({
            "entity": str(entity),
            "metric": metric,
            "period": period,
            "value": float(value),
            "formula": formula,
        })

    rev_tw = df["Revenue_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_lw = df["Revenue_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_ly = df["Revenue_LY"].sum(skipna=True)

    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "TW", num(rev_tw), "sum(Revenue_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LW", num(rev_lw), "sum(Revenue_LW)")
    if rev_ly > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LY", num(rev_ly), "sum(Revenue_LY)")
    if rev_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "WoW", num((rev_tw - rev_lw) / rev_lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100")
    if rev_ly > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "YoY", num((rev_tw - rev_ly) / rev_ly * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100")

    add("TOTAL", "units", "TW", num(df["Units_TW"].sum(skipna=True)), "sum(Units_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "units", "LW", num(df["Units_LW"].sum(skipna=True)), "sum(Units_LW)")
    u_tw = df["Units_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    u_lw = df["Units_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    if u_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "units", "WoW", num((u_tw - u_lw) / u_lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Units_TW) - sum(Units_LW)) / sum(Units_LW) * 100")

    o_tw = df["Orders_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    o_lw = df["Orders_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "TW", num(o_tw), "sum(Orders_TW)")
    if o_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "orders", "WoW", num((o_tw - o_lw) / o_lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Orders_TW) - sum(Orders_LW)) / sum(Orders_LW) * 100")

    # Top entities by this week's revenue
    top = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW"]).sort_values("Revenue_TW", ascending=False)
    for _, r in top.head(3).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", num(r["Revenue_TW"]), "Revenue_TW for entity")
        if pd.notna(r.get("Share_Pct")):
            add(r["Entity"], "share", "TW", num(r["Share_Pct"], 1),
                "Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")
        if pd.notna(r.get("Rank")):
            add(r["Entity"], "rank", "TW", num(r["Rank"], 0), "rank by Revenue_TW (1 = highest)")

    # Top 3 combined share
    if rev_tw > 0 and len(top) >= 3:
        add("TOTAL", "share", "TW", num(top.head(3)["Revenue_TW"].sum() / rev_tw * 100, 1),
            "sum(top 3 Revenue_TW) / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")

    # Biggest absolute WoW revenue movers
    d = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW"]).copy()
    d["delta"] = d["Revenue_TW"] - d["Revenue_LW"]
    if len(d):
        up = d.sort_values("delta", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(up["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(up["delta"]),
            "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW (largest absolute gain)")
        dn = d.sort_values("delta").iloc[0]
        if dn["Entity"] != up["Entity"]:
            add(dn["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(dn["delta"]),
                "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW (largest absolute decline)")

    # Biggest percentage WoW movers
    p = df.dropna(subset=["WoW_Pct"])
    if len(p):
        pu = p.sort_values("WoW_Pct", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(pu["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(pu["WoW_Pct"], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100 (largest gain)")
        pd_ = p.sort_values("WoW_Pct").iloc[0]
        if pd_["Entity"] != pu["Entity"]:
            add(pd_["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(pd_["WoW_Pct"], 1),
                "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100 (largest decline)")

    # Biggest YoY movers
    y = df.dropna(subset=["YoY_Pct"])
    if len(y):
        yu = y.sort_values("YoY_Pct", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(yu["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", num(yu["YoY_Pct"], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100 (largest gain)")
        yd = y.sort_values("YoY_Pct").iloc[0]
        if yd["Entity"] != yu["Entity"]:
            add(yd["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", num(yd["YoY_Pct"], 1),
                "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100 (largest decline)")

    # Absolute YoY delta for the largest entity
    big = top.iloc[0] if len(top) else None
    if big is not None and pd.notna(big.get("Revenue_LY")) and big["Revenue_LY"] > 0:
        add(big["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", num(big["Revenue_TW"] - big["Revenue_LY"]),
            "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY for the largest entity")

    # Units leader and orders leader
    if df["Units_TW"].notna().any():
        ul = df.loc[df["Units_TW"].idxmax()]
        add(ul["Entity"], "units", "TW", num(ul["Units_TW"]), "max(Units_TW) across entities")
    if df["Orders_TW"].notna().any():
        ol = df.loc[df["Orders_TW"].idxmax()]
        add(ol["Entity"], "orders", "TW", num(ol["Orders_TW"]), "max(Orders_TW) across entities")

    print(json.dumps(facts[:25]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
